The HWPX template substitution was successful. The core challenge in HWPX (and similar XML-based office formats) is that placeholders like `{{key}}` can be fragmented across multiple XML elements (e.g., `<hp:run>`) due to formatting or metadata. 

In this instance, the replacement was handled via a robust text-based approach followed by XML-aware cleanup. A critical success factor was the removal of layout-cache elements (specifically `<hp:lineSegArray>`). Removing these elements ensures the word processor recalculates character positions upon opening, preventing visual artifacts or overlapping text caused by the difference in length between the placeholder and the injected value. Future tasks involving HWPX should consistently target these layout-cache elements for removal whenever paragraph content is modified.
